annotation.title_en: Launch of the National Guidelines on AI Governance and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Malaysia (Deputy Prime Minister's speech)
named_instruments_referenced: Malaysia AI Governance and Ethics Guidelines (AIGE)
annotation.summary_en: Speech text by Malaysia's Deputy Prime Minister at the 20 September 2024 launch of the National AI Governance and Ethics (AIGE) guidelines. It stresses AI's economic benefits, says the guidelines complement the Cyber Security Act and PDPA, and announces the National AI Office and a proposed Data Commission. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AIGE guidelines reinforce existing laws such as the Cyber Security Act 2024 and amended PDPA 2010
National AI Office (NAIO) under MyDIGITAL Corporation to start operating in November 2024
Ministry of Digital to propose a Malaysia Data Commission and table a Data Sharing Bill
AIGE aligns with ASEAN AI governance and ethics guidance
'AI Untuk Rakyat' literacy programme reached over one million Malaysians
